Basically Voat is a platform that hosts communities. These communities are called Subverses and are created by the users.You can even create your own subverse for a subject you are interested in! When you find a community you can participate. You can open links and comment on threads, communicating thoughts and ideas with people who share a common interest with yourself.

Subverses have Moderators, a group of people who help keep the content of a subverse relevant and purge it of spam and trolls. We don't have much of that around here (yet) since the population is small. This has it's benefits though as it means your voice is heard more often.

Some communities have minor restrictions which are in place to prevent spam, though once you're active in a community and make a few posts it's not hard to become more involved.

Things worth noting also are:

  • When you comment or submit a post, above the text box (on pc) is a formatting bar which can help you make fancy posts with ease

  • The arrows to the left of a post are upvoat and downvoat buttons. Upvoat content you like or think is a good contribution or important, downvoat spam and irrelevant content. Downvoating isn't designed to be used for content you disagree with, though unfortunately some people use it that way.

  • You'll need 100 Comment Contribution Points before you can downvoat sitewide, some communities impose their own internal requirement also. You can check out your CCP at the top right of any page (there will be 3 numbers, hover over them to see what they are!)

Have fun and welcome to the party.
